paper_title: New axion and hidden photon constraints from a solar data global fit
coupling_convention: dimensionless chi, derived as chi = (chi*m)/m with chi*m < 1.8e-12 eV
notes: Solar global fit (helioseismology + neutrinos). Paper's headline hidden photon result: product chi*m < 1.8e-12 eV at 3-sigma, valid for m <~ 0.3 keV, most stringent from 3e-5 eV to 8 eV. Constraint is on the product chi*m (from longitudinal HP resonant emission), so chi = 1.8e-12 eV / m; I converted to chi vs mass along the diagonal line. The 3-sigma CL corresponds roughly to 0.997 (encoded as 0.90 among available options; actual is 3-sigma). Paper also gives an axion-photon bound g_agamma < 4.1e-10 GeV^-1 (flat, mass-independent for ALPs below ~eV) which is a competing result but less novel. | selector: text (sole candidate)
